episodes.title: Questions to Ask: Are You Caught in a Cult? Part 3 of 7
episodes.description:
"Asking ourselves these hard questions can be difficult." ~ Are You Caught in a Cult? Part 3

If you or someone you know feels like they may be in an unhealthy controlling relationship, there are some questions to ask with the purpose of gaining clarity.

Looking closely at someone or something we've trusted takes courage, and could bring up lots of emotions. Part three offers suggestions for questions one may wish to consider. Perhaps it’s time for reflection, a chance to pause and check in with self to see what feels true, at whatever pace feels right for you.

Part four continues with what comes next.

Learn more at GlueYourLifeBacktoBetter.com
